title: Subsystem Model
description: Portable subsystem model — the shareable standard. Construct-tagged components (nodes) plus runtime walkthroughs describing one subsystem of a codebase. Ontology: construct = what a node is, framework + stereotype = which framework pattern it plays, role = where it sits, process = where it runs, module = which source file/module the export belongs to. Symbol is the code identity; name is the display label (often derived from symbol). Host-only fields (local path binding, provenance, store ids, verification) are NOT part of this document; they belong on a hydrated envelope around it.

$schema.description: Pointer to this schema for editor autocomplete and validation.

components.description: Graph nodes — named units anchored to a real exported symbol (or external targets). Prefer 4–15 components per graph; split sprawling subsystems. Each component's `purl` identifies its repo/package; there is no document-level repo field.

walkthroughs.description: Ordered runtime walkthroughs (one per named behavior). Each step names from/to/mechanism and the concrete file:line where that seam fires.

createdAtCommits.description: The commit each referenced repo was at when the model was created — the coordinate system for every file:line. Keyed by purl repo key (purl with fragment stripped), value a commit sha. Immutable after create.

verifiedAtCommits.description: The commit each referenced repo was at when a full audit last passed against a clean referenced state. Same keying as createdAtCommits. Absent until an audit earns it.

construct.description: What the node IS as a declaration — drives node anatomy, color, badge, and verification. A module is its own subsystem: do not use a module construct; anchor to a concrete export (`symbol` + `file`) or publish the module as a separate graph. Runtime occurrences (variables, instances) are not constructs.

role.description: Where the node sits in the topology, orthogonal to construct. Boundary-crossing edges should terminate at an entry or a service. Retained state is `construct: store`, not a role.

proposed.description: Design / migration placeholder — not a live source declaration yet. Verification skips source checks until promoted. Keep a real construct for the intended shape.

framework.description: Framework that owns the stereotype vocabulary (open string). Examples: react, vue, nestjs, django, spring. Empty when the node is language-only. Pair with stereotype when the unit plays a framework pattern (e.g. framework: react + stereotype: component on construct: function).

stereotype.description: Framework-level pattern stamped on a language construct (open string). Examples: component, hook, middleware, controller, guard. Prefer this over inventing framework-specific constructs. Pair with framework when set.

declarationProvenance.description: Where `declaration` came from. `verified` is reserved for tool-extracted data; hand-authored declarations must be `authored` (also the default when declaration is present without provenance).

mechanism.description: Walkthrough hop mechanism — how `from` relates to `to` at a runtime site. `uses` = general dependency; `feeds` = data-flow into a processor; `produces` = emits an output; `writes`/`reads`/`watches` = retained-state interactions.

alias.description: Model-local stable alias, unique per model. Referenced by walkthrough `from` / `to`; edges point at the alias, not the location, so a file move or symbol rename leaves edges intact. Code identity (for composed multi-model views) lives on `purl` + `file` + `symbol`, not here.

name.description: Display label on the node. Prefer deriving from `symbol` (renderers often do). Required on the wire; when `symbol` is set, name may simply match it.

file.description: Repo-root-relative path of the source location this component lives in. Resolved against the checkout of the repo named by this component's `purl` (via the Alexandria registry). Empty string allowed for pure externals. `node_modules/` is rejected: installed artifacts are not part of the repo — model a third-party dependency as `construct: external` with `purl: pkg:npm/<package>` and no file.

purl.description: PURL identifying the repo or package (for subgraph grouping), e.g. `pkg:github/owner/name#path/to/file.ts`. When a graph spans multiple repos, distinct purl repo keys become package boundary frames (package → process → module nesting). Single-repo graphs do not draw package frames by default.

symbol.description: Code identity — a real declaration in `file` (function/class/const/interface/type/enum). Verified on create/update; mentions, imports, and call sites do not count. For standalone methods use `ClassName.methodName`. Source of truth for display when present.

entityKind.description: Actor kind for `construct: custom_entity` (e.g. Person, agent, queue), rendered as the node badge. Ignored on code constructs.

color.description: Node + declaration accent override (hex). Wins over the construct-derived color. Typically themes a custom entity (agent, queue).

purpose.description: One plain-text sentence shown on the node / as a doc comment under the declaration. Verb-first; no markdown.

process.description: Runtime process / deployment unit membership (e.g. `principal-studio/host`). Nodes sharing a process are drawn in one boundary region; nodes without one sit outside every process boundary. Nests inside a package frame when the graph is multi-repo.

module.description: Source-module membership — which file/module this export belongs to (e.g. `src/session/transcript.ts`). Nodes sharing a module are drawn in one boundary frame. Prefer anchoring each export as its real construct and setting module, rather than a module construct. Nests under process (and package when multi-repo).

layer.description: Semantic layout layer/phase (lower = closer to entry). When set, layout places the component in this layer for a left-to-right pipeline.

declaration.description: Structured declaration shape of the construct for the click panel (parameters, members, etc.). Hand-author when highlighting specific inputs/outputs; set `declarationProvenance` accordingly.

tokens.description: Pre-tokenized source text for the declaration panel. When present, the renderer skips client-side tokenization.

declarationRef.description: Anchored declaration location (start line + line hash). Usually populated by verify tooling, not hand-authored. Distinct from `declaration`, which is the structured shape.

file.description: Repo-root-relative path where the seam fires for this walkthrough.

purl.description: File-anchored purl of the seam site (e.g. `pkg:github/owner/name#path/to/file.ts`), mirroring component `purl`. Required: readers resolve the checkout from this instead of guessing the repo from the step's endpoint components.

symbol.description: Frame name for this hop — the function/method on the stack at the site. Required; the Walkthroughs list shows this instead of a bare mechanism + filename fallback.

annotation.description: Free-text note anchored to this hop's site line. Optional, informative only, never verified against source; viewers surface it in the codeview's annotation column.

steps.description: Ordered hops; array order is execution order.

color.description: Optional foreground color when pre-tokenized for a theme.

lineHash.description: Hash of the normalized declaration line at capture time (drift detection).

graphifyNodeId.description: Graphify node id when captured from an exact anchor.

capturedAt.description: ISO timestamp when this ref was recorded.

constructDeclaration.description: Discriminated structured declaration of a construct (`kind`). Hand-authored declarations should set component.declarationProvenance to authored.

hostClass.description: Owning class name. Required for standalone method components.

typeDeclaration.description: Type-family declaration (interface / type alias / enum). Prefer structured buckets; use `rhs` when none fit.

rhs.description: Verbatim RHS escape hatch; wins over structured buckets when set.

label.description: Facet-only label; no backing source declaration.

properties.description: Retained state members (module-level consts or fields).

storage.description: Where the retained state physically lives / who mediates access. Authored — graphify cannot infer it: `memory` = process-lifetime RAM, `disk` = this process reads/writes the filesystem, `external` = mediated by another system (db/service).

valueType.description: The type of the retained state itself, as a declaration declares its type: `Map<string, FeedState>` for a state block, a row/record type for a table. Orthogonal to `storage`. A store with no `properties` and no `valueType` has no declared type.

valueTypeRef.description: Resolvable target of `valueType` when the graph has an edge for it — makes the store's type navigable like a property `typeRef`.

customEntityAttribute.description: A single authored attribute on a custom entity — free-form key/value.

customEntityDeclaration.description: Declaration for `construct: custom_entity` (an actor — Person/agent/queue). Authored, never extracted: there is no backing source declaration. Rendered as `entity 'Name' — kind` plus the key/value attribute lines.

attributes.description: Authored key/value pairs (e.g. slack, permission, level).
